title: Swami Vivekananda's Birthday Celebrations 2023 | Belur Math | 14 January 2023 |
description:
The 161st birthday of Srimat Swami Vivekananda will be celebrated at Belur Math on Saturday, 14 January 2023, according to the Vishuddha Siddhanta almanac. The celebrations will be streamed live on Youtube and Facebook from 8:00 am onwards.
